about: P2-S8-T01 (08 S8.1, 10 'Performance budget'). Every page the site builds, in one of three route groups, with its size budget: site/.size-limit.js reads this through scripts/route_groups.mjs and size-limit fails the job when a family is over. A route is the page's URL: {name} is one path segment, {...name} one or more. js is the JavaScript budget: '0 B' is counted in raw bytes and allows only 09 S9's pre-paint line; any other limit is gzip -9 per file, every script counted, the pre-paint line included. weight is the page-weight budget, what a reader downloads for the family's heaviest page: its HTML, stylesheets, scripts and images gzip -9 per file, and its fonts as sent (a woff2 is compressed already). A KiB is 1,024 bytes. A family with js null is measured and printed but not yet budgeted; 'budget' says why. A family with 'pending' names the task that routes it and the page source it will add: until then it has no page, and any other family with no built page fails, because a gate that measured nothing has passed nothing (site/test/size-budgets.test.mjs fails once the page source exists, so the task that adds it drops 'pending'). A built page that no family claims fails too (10: 'It also fails when a route ... maps to no row').
